[Section] Experiments and Results ::: Pre-Processing
[source_id=28] We find mentions of users, numbers, hashtags, URLs and common emoticons and replace them with the tokens <user>,<number>,<hashtag>,<url>,<emoticon>. We also find elongated words and convert them into short and standard format; for example, converting yeeeessss to yes. With hashtags that include some tokens without any with space between them, we replace them by their textual counterparts; for example, we convert hashtag “#notsexist" to “not sexist". All punctuation marks, unknown uni-codes and extra delimiting characters are removed, but we keep all stop words because our model trains the sequence of words in a text directly. We also convert all tweets to lower case.
